name: International Business and Politics
summary: Explore how companies, governments and international organisations influence each other. Business economics, politics and qualitative and quantitative methods help you analyse regulation, markets and global challenges.

separateFrom.reason: A different subject: roughly 40 per cent politics beside economics and mathematics, where International Business is broad business economics. The names say how they differ; each is its own application.

notes: Study structure describes current programme pages and their 2026/2027 regulations; autumn 2027 regulations require a recheck.

description: Explore how companies, governments and international organisations influence each other. Business economics, politics and qualitative and quantitative methods help you analyse regulation, markets and global challenges.

structure.assessment: Written sit-in examinations, home assignments and oral examinations; the format differs by course.
structure.flexibility: Fifth-semester electives can be taken at CBS or another university, through an exchange, or partly replaced by an academic internship.
structure.studyAbroad: Exchange is an option during the fifth semester; partner places and approval apply.
structure.teachingStyle: Lectures introduce theory; smaller exercise classes apply it to assignments and cases, with group work.
